description: Frozen synthetic routing cases. Subjects are invented; no prompts contain private content. Ten held-out prompts in each family share one scenario label for clustered uncertainty estimates.

catalog.description: Create a graphical architecture or workflow diagram.
Render an explicitly supplied Mermaid diagram.
Find, check, classify, or import one public research paper.
Check confidential paper-review assignments in the private workflow.
Track Canvas coursework and reconcile student tasks.
Capture or organize personal Todoist tasks.
Search or manage explicitly requested Apple Mail content.
Use direct gws Gmail for an explicitly requested multi-account workflow.
Review broad UI layout, typography, colors, and accessibility.
Ship toolbox changes when explicitly invoked.
Explain a substantive technical concept clearly.
Read or compare public community discussions.
Create reproducible publication figures from research data.
Look up current public information on the web.
Inspect or run commands in the local checkout.
Read a private Docmost page when the connector is available.
